confusables.note: هم‌آوا با bear؛ اما bare یعنی برهنه، خالی و بدون پوشش

homograph.note: CLAUDE.md names this case explicitly: the verb (endure / have as a feature) and the noun (the animal) are unrelated for a learner. Candidate split: bear-1 (v, تحمل کردن) / bear-2 (n, خرس).

senses.definition: to have or show a particular quality or relation, as in "bear a resemblance to" something

examples.en: The copy bears no resemblance to the original painting.
examples.fa: آن نسخه هیچ شباهتی به نقاشی اصلی ندارد.

senses.definition: to accept or endure something unpleasant without complaining

examples.en: He could not bear the noise from the street any longer.
examples.fa: او دیگر نمی‌توانست سروصدای خیابان را تحمل کند.

senses.definition: a large heavy wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws

examples.en: A brown bear was seen near the campsite at dawn.
examples.fa: سپیده‌دم خرسی قهوه‌ای نزدیک اردوگاه دیده شد.
